scripts.db:migrate: docker compose run --rm backend python apps/backend/manage.py migrate
scripts.telegram:login: docker compose run --rm backend python apps/backend/manage.py telegram_login
scripts.telegram:channels: docker compose run --rm backend python apps/backend/manage.py telegram_channels
scripts.ingest:telegram: docker compose run --rm backend python apps/backend/manage.py ingest_telegram
scripts.ingest:schedule: docker compose run --rm backend python apps/backend/manage.py enqueue_scheduled_ingestion
scripts.api:schema: docker compose run --rm backend python apps/backend/manage.py spectacular --file packages/api-client/openapi.json --format openapi-json --validate --fail-on-warn
scripts.api:generate: corepack pnpm api:schema && corepack pnpm api:types
scripts.api:check: docker compose run --rm backend python scripts/check_openapi.py && corepack pnpm --filter @ntu-events/api-client generated:check
scripts.format: docker compose run --rm backend ruff format apps/backend src scripts tests && corepack pnpm exec prettier --write apps/web packages/api-client package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: docker compose run --rm backend ruff format --check apps/backend src scripts tests && corepack pnpm exec prettier --check apps/web packages/api-client package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json
scripts.lint: docker compose run --rm backend ruff check apps/backend src scripts tests && corepack pnpm -r --if-present lint
scripts.test: docker compose run --rm backend pytest && corepack pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.django:check: docker compose run --rm backend python apps/backend/manage.py check --database default
scripts.migrations:check: docker compose run --rm backend python apps/backend/manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm django:check && corepack pnpm migrations:check && corepack pnpm api:check && corepack pnpm test
